About Nightfall:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About the role:

About the role

We're hiring an Senior MDR Manager, reporting to our VP of Customer Experience, to build and lead Nightfall's Managed Detection and Response program for data security. You'll lead our team of analysts, own incident oversight and escalations, and shape MDR into a scalable service our customers rely on.

This is a builder role. You'll set up the program's processes, tune detection policies with customers, and serve as the senior escalation point when something matters. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Technical Support, and you'll translate threat findings into clear security outcomes for customers and leadership.

You've done this before at a security company like ours, and you're excited to do it again at an earlier stage, with AI built into how the team works.

What you'll do

Lead the analyst team

  • Manage, coach, and grow our MDR analysts, setting clear expectations for triage quality, response time, and customer communication

  • Take part in customer-facing on-call and build the team's on-call rotation, shift handoffs, and workload planning as it scales

  • Hire and onboard new analysts as customer demand grows

Build and scale the MDR program

  • Design the MDR operating model: playbooks, runbooks, SLAs, severity tiers, and escalation paths

  • Define how MDR is packaged, onboarded, and delivered as a solution customers can buy and expand

  • Partner with GTM and channel partners to position MDR and support customer and partner conversations

Own escalations and incident oversight

  • Act as the senior escalation point for high-severity data exposure events and customer incidents

  • Oversee incident investigation and response from detection through resolution and post-incident review

  • Make sure every escalation ends with a clear root cause, outcome, and follow-up

Drive policy tuning and detection quality

  • Work with customers and analysts to tune detection policies, reduce false positives, and raise signal quality

  • Turn recurring patterns into improved default policies and product feedback

Partner across the company

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on what analysts and customers see

  • Partner with Technical Support and Customer Success on handoffs, shared customers, and escalations

Report and communicate outcomes

  • Translate technical threat findings into clear business and security outcomes for customers, executives, and CISOs

  • Build reporting on MDR performance: volume, response times, SLA adherence, risk reduction, and customer value

  • Lead customer-facing reviews and high-level conversations with security leaders

Use AI to scale the team

  • Bring AI tools into triage, investigation, summarization, and reporting so the team can do more without adding headcount at the same rate

What you bring

  • Experience building or leading an MDR, SOC, or managed security service at a security vendor (DLP, data security, insider risk, EDR/XDR, CASB, or SSE)

  • Experience managing security analysts, including hiring, coaching, and setting performance standards

  • A track record as the senior escalation point for security incidents, with sound judgment under pressure

  • Hands-on experience with detection policy tuning and reducing false positives

  • Ability to explain technical findings to executives and customers in terms of risk and business impact

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to turn field insights into product improvements

  • Comfort building reporting and metrics for service performance and customer value

  • Regular use of AI tools in security operations or team workflows, and curiosity about where they can go further

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with confidence leading conversations with CISOs and security leaders

Nice to have

  • Experience launching an MDR or managed service from an early stage, not only running a mature one

  • Background in data security, DLP, or insider risk specifically

  • Hands-on endpoint deployment experience

  • Experience supporting channel partners or MSSPs

  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR tools and incident response frameworks (NIST, MITRE ATT&CK)

  • Security certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, or similar

Environment

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.
